About Austrian Airlines AG

Discover a world full of possibilities. Make your professional dreams come true at Austrian Airlines. We are an open and warmhearted community where internationality and open-mindedness play a major role. Hospitality and service-orientation are our top priorities, we put people - our employees just like our guests first. We are focusing on creating an inspiring working environment where everyone can feel at home. Together we can create unforgettable experiences and memories. Let us #CreateJourneysTogether

We are looking for 5 Internship Offer Pricing Austria Revenue Management (all genders) Have you ever wondered how airlines maximize their revenues? Do you want to collect first experience in the commercial heart of an airline? If yes, then we are looking forward to your application. 

Start: February 2027 - 6 months fixed-term

Tasks

You are currently enrolled at university, love the aviation industry and would like to expand your practical knowledge? 

 * You are analyzing current performance development of the Lufthansa Group in the Austrian market

 * You are supporting the pricing and steering teams in developing their commercial strategies

 * You are preparing presentations for management decisions

 * You are collaborating with various teams across the Lufthansa Group, such as Marketing, Sales and Revenue Management 

Creating the future together

Together we bring people and cultures closer and give our work real meaning. Convinced? Then apply now!

Requirements

We do not seek a specific profile, but are happy to have diverse mindsets in our team. However, some basic requirements are:

 * You are enrolled in a Master's degree program for the entire period of the internship (current matriculation needs to be added to the application)

 * You enjoy working with numbers and analytical tasks

 * You have the ability to work on complex commercial questions

 * You work independently and are well-organized

 * You are fascinated by the airline industry

 * You have very good spoken and written English skills

 * You have a very good MS Office user knowledge

 * You have an unrestricted work permit for Austria / EU

Company Description
Our production unit takes pride in offering top-tier luxury airline catering that is both elegant and sophisticated. Our team is dedicated to crafting a one-of-a-kind experience that is attractive to even the most discerning passengers. We focus on providing exceptional quality, first-class service, and an exquisite range of menu options that are sure to impress. 1 Head Chef - Indian Cuisine Job Description

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Head Chef specializing in Indian Cuisine to join our team in Vienna. Our production kitchen serves high-end airline clients, and we are looking for someone with relevant experience in cooking Indian cuisine in similar operations. 

In this role, you'll be responsible for managing the day-to-day operations of the Indian cuisine section in our production kitchen. You'll supervise and lead a team of chefs, while also training and mentoring them in Indian cuisine techniques, ingredients, and cooking methods. 

Your keen eye for detail and dedication to excellence will ensure that food preparation and presentation adhere to both company and industry standards. With your leadership skills, you'll be able to manage inventory and purchasing of Indian cuisine ingredients, equipment, and supplies. 

 * Lead and manage a team of kitchen staff to ensure that all dishes are prepared to the highest standards of quality and consistency 

 * Manage stock and ordering supplies, including authentic Indian ingredients, ensuring that all products are fresh and of the highest quality 

 * Continually review and improve processes to ensure maximum efficiency and quality of output 

 * Ensuring the timely delivery of food, while maintaining the highest levels of quality and consistency 

 * Managing and training a team of skilled chefs and kitchen staff 

 * Maintaining a clean and organized kitchen environment 

 * Maintaining the highest levels of food safety and sanitation standards 

 * Travel to international events (Formula 1, UEFA Champions League Final, ATP Madrid, etc.) 

Qualifications

 * Minimum of 5 years' experience in high-end operations cooking Indian cuisine 

 * In-depth knowledge of Indian ingredients, techniques, and flavours 

 * Experience in managing a team of kitchen staff 

 * Ability to create and develop menus that showcase both traditional and innovative Indian cuisine 

 * Excellent communication in English - Indian is a plus 

 * Strong attention to detail and ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment 

Additional Information

We believe that our employees are the driving force behind our success and strive to create a positive and supportive work environment. As a member of our team, you will have access to a range of benefits, including:

 * A monthly salary starting at €3.500 gross with the willingness to overpay with appropriate experience and qualifications 

 * A wonderful workplace to call home, events, fun colleagues, and all other regular salary/benefits

 * A business where you can have a real impact - we're not afraid of new ideas!

 * Genuine career development opportunities, both nationally and internationally

 * The opportunity to work with and represent one of the most innovative players in the luxury global gourmet entertainment market

DO & CO is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status

We build AI voice agents for small and medium-sized businesses so they never miss a call and can focus on the work they actually love.

Our AI handles every call automatically. But voice is just the beginning. Our vision: to build the world's first fully automated CRM.

11,000+ customers. >€15M ARR. ~30% monthly growth.

We live ownership. You're responsible for your projects and tasks end-to-end. No politics, few meetings, direct feedback. At fonio you'll build alongside the smartest and most ambitious people around.

Join us now to be part of one of Europe's most exciting growth stories! 1 Junior Customer Success Manager (DACH) (m/f/d) Your Role

As Junior Customer Success Manager for Activation in DACH, you make sure every new German-speaking customer goes from "just signed" to "fonio picks up our calls every day". You own the first weeks of the customer journey: setting up their AI assistant, testing and fine-tuning it, and getting it live on their phone line.

You'll spend most of your time in onboarding calls with customers and inside the fonio platform. You learn how every feature works and figure out the best setup for each customer, whether that's a dental practice in Munich, a law firm in Vienna or a car workshop in Zurich.

 

What to expect

 * Run onboarding calls with new DACH customers and set up their AI assistant together with them

 * Translate each customer's business into a working setup: prompt, knowledge base, call transfers, notifications and integrations

 * Test and fine-tune assistants until they're ready to go live, so customers don't get stuck in "almost done"

 * Help customers connect their phone system and get call forwarding running

 * Follow up with customers who signed but aren't active yet, and get them over the line

 * Become a power user of the platform: learn how each feature works and which setup fits which use case

 * Bring patterns and friction points from onboardings back to Product and CS to improve templates, guides and the product

 * Hand activated customers over to Customer Success with a clean setup and clear notes

 * Track your onboardings and activation results in HubSpot

 

Who We're Looking For

 * 0-2 years of experience in a customer-facing role (onboarding, support, CS, sales, hospitality or customer service) or a strong graduate profile. Internships count.

 * German, fluent English

 * Basic technical skills and real curiosity about how things work. You enjoy clicking through a platform until you understand it, and you're not scared of webhooks, APIs or phone settings.

 * You like solving puzzles: "How do I build this for this customer?" excites you

 * You explain things simply and stay patient with non-technical customers, by phone or video

 * Structured: you can run several onboardings in parallel without dropping anything

 * Hands-on and quick to learn. You take initiative and don't wait to be told what to do.

 * Willing to relocate to Vienna

What We Offer

 * €50,000-55,000

 * You'll learn AI and voice tech faster than anywhere else, with a real path into Customer Success, Solutions or Forward Deployment

 * Lunch and dinner are on us. Every day.

 * The fridge is always full: Red Bull, Mate, Cola, Almdudler and more

 * Need a tool, course or book? It's yours. No approval loops.

 * Your setup, your choice: pick the gear you want to work with

 * A product customers actually love: 4.5 stars on Trustpilot, Google and OMR. It mostly sells itself.

 * Onsite in Vienna with a team that's here to do the best work of their careers

 

Hiring Process

 * 20 min intro call

 * 30 min skill interview

 * 15 min with interview with our CCO

 * 20 min culture call with our Founders
